name: Secondary Enervate

effects.description: On Hit: gain a stack of flat crit chance (absolute percentage points, not scaled by base). Stacks reset after landing a rank-dependent number of big crits (crit tier >= 2). Both the stack gain and the big-crit counter are rate-limited to 30/s.

hit_counting_notes: Hitscan hitting multiple enemies at once (Multishot or Punch Through) counts as 1 hit.
Projectile and non-chained beam attacks hitting multiple enemies at once count as multiple hits.
AoE attacks always count as 1 hit.
Shotgun sidearm pellets are tied to Multishot and do not count as separate hits.
Expiring Blast procs count as a hit; Blast explosions from max stacks or a kill do not.
Hits on an Arctic Eximus Snow Globe build the bonus without triggering the reset (object health cannot take crits).

verification.notes: Flat crit chance is additive/absolute: Lato (10% base) with 7 stacks = 10% + 7x10% = 80% (source: wiki). 'Big crit' = crit tier >= 2 (source: wiki, confirmed). Still needs in-game measurement to confirm: whether a hit's own stack survives when that same hit triggers the reset, and whether the 30/s cap is a min-interval or rolling window.
